name: Cubing East Auckland Newcomer Open 2026
information:
Cubing East Auckland Newcomer Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is specifically designed to provide the best possible experience for new competitiors, featuring generous cutoffs and progression. 

For this competition, registration will be FREE for all first-time competitors. If this is your first competition, simply register [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AucklandNewcomerOpen2026/register), but do not complete payment. The organisation team will then manually approve your free registration.
